as_told.title: Marcos Vinícius showed his alien video on a CD at home

plain: A surgeon named Italo Venturelli, who says his hospital in Varginha, Brazil, operated on an alien in 1996, says a colleague named Marcos Vinícius had a video of the being and showed it to many people at his house. Venturelli tells it as something he knows first hand: visitors would sit on the sofa while Vinícius played it on his computer, probably from a CD, "repeatedly sometimes." If true, film of the creature would have existed and been seen by several people.
